allowanceReason: yarn build syncs board directory data from bitsocialnet/lists, and that data is in the startup bundle
ceilingReason: index.html carries the static board frames: a desktop and a mobile template shared by every directory board plus each board's title and winner line (about 59 KB raw, 6 KB gzip); the English interface strings ship with the app (about 37 KB raw), as every language falls back to them and the first render waits for them; the MD5 filter's matching (its store, list parsing, hide checks and post menu action, with its English strings) has to run on the first render so filtered posts never show, about 11 KB raw (4 KB gzip), while its notice and its hashing worker load later; every directory's rules end with the same no-bots/no-AI rule, which the startup bundle carries in the directory defaults once per directory, about 9.5 KB raw (0.3 KB gzip); a new thread with a file opens as a pending post at once and is checked by the board's spam blocker before its file uploads, so the form's hand-off, the pending upload page with the file row built from the local file, the pre-check hook, and the posts still uploading, each running on its own, add about 10 KB raw, while the pre-check's planning and signing code loads on the first post with a file; the Halloween theme (a port of 4chan's spooky.css) has to paint with the first frame on October 31, so its theme variables and its global and per-component rules ship in the startup CSS, with the small skeleton overlay component, about 6 KB raw (1.7 KB gzip); the Halloween theme's phone rules (its dark theme and rules restored on phones) ship in the startup CSS as well, about 8 KB raw in index.html, and the other changes pushed with them (copying the full error from Connection Error and Failed, the bitsocial-react-hooks 0.1.65 upgrade) add about 1 KB raw on the home page and 4 KB on a board; a post shows its comment.gallery files beside its link's file on the first render, and the post form and reply modal take several files on boards that allow galleries, about 11 KB raw on a board visit and 2 KB on the home page; the post menus reading the MD5 quick filter setting and the challenge and reply modal layout fixes add about 0.6 KB raw on a board visit; 5chan.app counts page views and failed posts, so the route tracker at the app root and the failure tracking of each submitted post in the post form, reply modal and publish hooks add about 2 KB raw on the home page and 3.5 KB on a board visit, while Vercel's script and the path sanitizer load after the first render and only on 5chan.app; stopping board updates that nothing on screen shows (bitsocial-react-hooks 0.2.0 keeps a board updating only while a hook or feed shows it, and 5chan judges a paused board by its last fetch and refreshes it before a cross-board quote gives up) adds about 5.3 KB raw on the home page and 5.7 KB on a board visit (about 1.5 KB gzip)
